purpose: Prioritised, machine-readable research targets to acquire real Mall@Reds retailer + product coverage. Research execution artifact — NO scraping/ingestion performed. Built on docs/sprint-2f/mallreds-retailer-targets.json (repository truth).

rules.no_invented_tenants: Only retailers with repository/audit evidence are listed as known. Additional Mall@Reds tenants require the official directory (see mallreds-map-source-targets.json) and are NOT guessed here.
rules.live_verification: Every field describing an EXTERNAL fact (public API existence, catalogue availability, chain size) is marked requires_live_verification=true. Do not treat model memory as final truth.

priority_scoring: priority_score 1-100 = shopper_impact(0-40) + acquisition_leverage(0-30) + reuse_across_malls(0-20) + evidence_readiness(0-10). Higher = do first.
